metadata.author: Your Name
comp_titles: The Vanishing Half by Brit Bennett
Everything I Never Told You by Celeste Ng
The Night Watchman by Louise Erdrich

vision.tone: Contemplative and emotionally nuanced, with moments of quiet revelation
vision.style_notes: Lyrical but not overwrought. Intimate third-person that moves between characters. Sensory-rich without being purple. Emphasis on interiority and psychological realism.
vision.central_question: Can we ever truly know the people we love, or do we only know the versions of them we've constructed from incomplete memories?
vision.emotional_core: The bittersweet recognition that love persists even when understanding fails
